resources.string: Show or hide the encrypted and decrypted user data
No users yet. Sign in and answer "Create" to add one, or paste blobs from another device here.
Each entry carries its own salt next to its blob — a blob without its salt cannot be decrypted. Nothing here reveals a username or a password.
Nothing decrypted. Sign in to unlock a blob; the plaintext appears here.
Locked. Press Unlock and enter your password to see the plaintext.
Read-only, and never stored in the clear — this is the plaintext held in memory for the current sign-in. Restarting the app keeps the session but not the key, so it has to be unlocked again.
Paste the roster message here… Parsing extracts the first two 🗓️ date blocks and their player lists. The cards above update as soon as you paste.
Signing in tries every stored blob with this password and keeps the one whose encrypted username matches; a new username offers to create a user.
